title: SHEIN Brazil Black Friday 2026: when it starts, how long it lasts and the zero import tax up to US$ 50
seoTitle: SHEIN Black Friday 2026 Brazil: dates, taxes and coupons
description: When SHEIN's Black Friday starts and ends, the 2023 to 2025 calendar, what changes with import tax at zero on orders up to US$ 50, National or international shipping, coupons, points, payment and returns.
metaDescription: SHEIN Black Friday 2026: the 2023 to 2025 calendar, zero import tax up to US$ 50 and the ICMS that remains, National Shipping, coupons, points and returns.

cons: The "up to 90%" applies to some items, not the whole cart

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: SHEIN has not yet announced the 2026 Black Friday, which falls on November 27. Going by past years, the deals start earlier, together with 11.11, and run to the end of the month. On an international order of up to US$ 50 there is no import tax, only ICMS; see the math, the coupon and the 4CW5Y code below.

contentSections.heading: When SHEIN's Black Friday starts
paragraphs: SHEIN combines 11.11 and Black Friday into a single campaign, with phases that raise the maximum discount until the end of the month. The table below gathers what SHEIN announced in the last three years. The 2026 calendar is not out yet.

comparisonTable.caption: Phases and maximum discounts announced by SHEIN Brazil, by the press that published the announcements and by the brand's profiles. The "up to" applies to some items.
rows: up to 80% at the start, up to 85% the week before and up to 90% on Black Friday and the Saturday after, with 48 hours of free shipping in Black Friday week
11.11: up to 85% at the start, 90% the week before and 95% on the days of 11.11. Black Friday: up to 90%, rising to 95% in the last five days of the month
up to 90% on more than 800,000 items in the first phase, with free shipping in several categories; in Black Friday week, up to 95% on more than 800,000 items

postParagraphs: In 2026, 11.11 falls on a Wednesday and Black Friday on a Friday. If SHEIN repeats the pattern, the deals should start between the end of October and the beginning of November and run to the end of the month. This is an estimate based on past years, and this guide is updated when SHEIN announces the 2026 campaign.
In all three years, the maximum discount went up near the end: if you can wait, you gain, and if you need a hard-to-find size, don't wait for the last phase.

contentSections.heading: "Up to 90%" is not the whole cart
paragraphs: The campaign percentage is the biggest discount on some items. Most of the catalog has smaller discounts, and the price of each piece changes across the phases. To avoid falling for the big number in the ad:
bullets: Save the pieces to your wishlist before the campaign starts and note today's price.
Compare the wishlist price with the later phases: in the last three years, the maximum discount went up in the final stretch.
Look at the final price in the cart, with shipping and taxes, and not only the percentage in the announcement.
If the piece comes in a hard-to-find size, don't wait for the last phase: stock may run out first.

contentSections.heading: Tax on Black Friday: what changed in 2026
paragraphs: SHEIN is in Remessa Conforme, so the tax shows up at checkout, together with the order. As a rule there is no extra charge on delivery, but the Receita Federal (Brazil's tax authority) may reassess the value of the package, and that changes the tax due. On May 13, 2026, import tax on purchases up to US$ 50 was zeroed. Law 15.502/2026 confirmed that the government can keep the rate at zero in that range.

The calculation applies per order and uses the product value plus shipping, already with discounts and the coupon. So the Black Friday discount can bring an order below US$ 50. The limit is in dollars: checkout shows your order's taxes before payment.

comparisonTable.caption: From SHEIN Brazil's tax page. The 17% ICMS applies in most states; Amapá has 18%, Pará 19%, and Acre, Alagoas, Bahia, Ceará, Paraíba, Piauí, Rio Grande do Norte, Roraima and Sergipe have 20%.
rows: 60%, minus US$ 30 off the tax amount
17% to 20%, also on the import tax

postParagraphs: SHEIN says it still covers part of the ICMS, only on the product value. The size of that subsidy varies from customer to customer, by criteria the store does not disclose, and it does not cover the ICMS charged on the import tax.
**National Shipping** products, which are already in Brazil, pay no import tax. And the import tax you paid is not refunded if you return the piece after it has shipped.

contentSections.heading: National Shipping or international?
paragraphs: In the same search, SHEIN mixes products from abroad and from sellers in Brazil (National Shipping): the difference weighs on the final price and on the discount rules.
bullets: **National Shipping:** no import tax. Each seller has its own shipping, deadline and conditions, and SHEIN points do not apply to these items.

**International:** goes through customs, with taxes charged at checkout. SHEIN takes 3 to 5 days to process the order before shipping, and the name on the order must match your CPF (the Brazilian taxpayer number).
**Deadline:** the delivery time and shipping cost appear on the order page before you pay. The order may arrive in more than one package.
**Delays:** SHEIN has a free On-Time Delivery service that gives 200 SHEIN points or R$ 10 in wallet credit if the order does not arrive by the estimated date.

contentSections.heading: Coupons, points and the 4CW5Y code
paragraphs: Under SHEIN's coupon policy, one platform coupon applies per order. If the cart has products from Brazilian sellers, you can also use that seller's store coupon: at most two coupons, one of each type. Each coupon has an expiry date, and one not used in time becomes unavailable.
SHEIN points are worth US$ 1 per 100 points and take off up to 30% of the product value, not counting shipping and taxes. They do not apply to items from Brazilian sellers.

4CW5Y is not a coupon: it is Cecília's referral code for SHEIN Brazil. You search for 4CW5Y in the SHEIN app and check the conditions shown for your account. SHEIN campaigns change all the time: check the current ones on the store page here on the site before placing your order.

contentSections.heading: How to pay on Black Friday
paragraphs: SHEIN accepts Pix, Brazilian credit cards in up to 6 installments, boleto, PayPal and Pagaleve. Boleto takes up to 3 days to clear, and the piece may sell out in the meantime: on Black Friday, prefer card or PayPal.
If you need a refund, Pix is the fastest: SHEIN processes it within 24 hours, and the bank takes 1 to 3 business days. On a credit card, the bank takes 3 to 8 business days, sometimes up to 30 days.

contentSections.heading: Exchanges and returns after Black Friday

image.alt: Gráfico de barras com o prazo para devolver publicado por cada loja no Brasil: Temu 90 dias a partir da compra; SHEIN 20 dias, Shopee 7 dias e AliExpress 7 dias a partir do recebimento
image.caption: Na SHEIN, o prazo para devolver é de 20 dias a partir do recebimento, mais que na Shopee e no AliExpress. Regras publicadas pelas lojas.

bullets: **Deadline:** up to 20 days after you receive it, even if you simply did not like the piece.

**Items that can only be returned within 7 days:** bodysuits, swimwear, underwear, earrings and piercings, and pet products, plus cosmetics, party items and craft items with the seal broken. These can only be returned within the 7-day withdrawal period, counted from delivery.
**Return shipping:** the first return of each order is free, via Correios, Jadlog or Total Express. From the second on, SHEIN deducts R$ 45 from the refund for each return.
**Coupon:** on a partial return, the coupon counts as used and is not given back; if the order falls below the minimum, the difference comes out of the refund.
**Tax:** the import tax paid is not refunded once the order has shipped.

contentSections.heading: Before you pay: what to check
bullets: Whether the product is National Shipping or international.
Whether the international order came to US$ 50 or less, counting shipping and with discounts already applied.
How much the ICMS came to in the order summary.
Whether the coupon went through and the points were applied.
The delivery time, if the purchase is a Christmas present.
Whether the piece is among the items that can only be returned within 7 days.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: When does SHEIN's Black Friday start in 2026? SHEIN has not announced it yet. In 2024 the deals started together with 11.11, at the end of October, and in 2025 they were already live in early November. The 2026 Black Friday falls on the last Friday of November.
How long does SHEIN's Black Friday last? In 2024 and 2025, until the end of November. In 2023, until the Saturday after Black Friday.
What is SHEIN's 11.11? It is the Singles' Day sale, on the 11th day of the 11th month. SHEIN combines 11.11 and Black Friday into a single campaign, with discount phases until the end of the month.

Is there tax on SHEIN purchases on Black Friday? There is ICMS, from 17% to 20% depending on the state, on every international purchase. Import tax is zero on orders up to US$ 50 and 60%, minus US$ 30 off the tax amount, above that.
Does SHEIN's zero tax apply to any purchase? It applies to an international order of up to US$ 50, counting product and shipping, with discounts already applied. Above that, import tax comes back.
Do National Shipping products pay import tax? No. National Shipping products are already in Brazil and pay no import tax.
Can I use more than one coupon on SHEIN? One SHEIN coupon per order. If the cart has products from Brazilian sellers, you can add that seller's store coupon.
Is 4CW5Y a discount coupon? No. It is Cecília's SHEIN Brazil referral code: you search for the code in the SHEIN app and see the conditions for your account.
Is there free shipping on SHEIN's Black Friday? Free shipping changes with each phase of the campaign: check yours in the cart before paying.
How long do I have to return what I bought on Black Friday? Up to 20 days after you receive it. Underwear, swimwear, bodysuits, earrings and a few other items can only be returned within 7 days.
